answer.item: Utahime Iori was born on February 18, 1987.

questions.question: How did Utahime and Mei Mei escape the spirit's barrier in 2006?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: As the two discuss what to do, Satoru Gojo arrives and frees them from the barrier.

questions.question: Why did Gojo ask Utahime to investigate the Kyoto college?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: When Utahime asks why he wants her to investigate since she could be the spy, Gojo replies that she doesn't have the nerve, which causes her to throw her cup of tea at him.

questions.question: What did the three find when they tested the screen around the event site?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: They decide to test out the screen and find that Gojo is the only one that can't enter, both Utahime and Yoshinobu head inside.

questions.question: What did Gojo want to know when he contacted Utahime days later?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: Utahime is contacted by Gojo, to find out if she had found any new information.

questions.question: What did Utahime reveal about Mechamaru before the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: Utahime reveals that Mechamaru's real identity is Kokichi Muta, and explains how his puppet manipulation ability works.

questions.question: What did Utahime do on the day of the fight with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Utahime Iori/Synopsis

answer.item: Utahime activates her cursed technique, Solo Forbidden Area, in order to amplify Gojo's maximum cursed energy output, causing him to launch a far more powerful Purple.
